title: Noon at the Zoo
lines: Meg went with her school to the zoo.
At noon she got a bag of food.
A goat came up and took the bag!
Meg ran, but the goat was fast.
It went up on the roof of the shed.
Sam got a long tool and got it back.
The food was gone, but the spoon was not.

questions.ask: Where did the goat go with the bag?
questions.listenFor: Up on the roof of the shed. Have them find that line.

questions.ask: What was left in the bag at the end?
questions.listenFor: Only the spoon - the food was gone. Listen for both parts.

questions.ask: Do you think Meg was cross at the goat? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. Ask what in the story makes them think so.
